title: Effective elastic wave transmission through a periodically voided interface
summary: Effective interface conditions for a periodically voided thin layer separating two homogeneous bulk regions are derived for the elastic wave equation by taking the simultaneous limit of vanishing layer periodicity and layer thickness. The limit problems are obtained using the unfolding method for thin perforated domains. We consider three different scalings of the material parameters in the layer that characterise its stiffness, each leading to a distinct type of interface condition and requiring the solution of scaling-dependent cell problems.
